description.value: An exploratory study comparing pretreatment functional and structural MRI measures in cannabis-dependent participants and healthy comparison participants, including relationships with subsequent abstinence during behavioral treatment.

spans.text: In this study, we explored the relationship between pretreatment striatal function and brain structure and short-term abstinence in response to behavioral treatments for cannabis dependence.

description.value: Participants with cannabis dependence underwent pretreatment MRI scanning before participating in a 12-week randomized clinical trial of behavioral treatments; healthy comparison participants were scanned as a comparison group.
